subtitles.en:
Hello everyone! Welcome to AB Slow Spanish
Cafe.
subtitles.zh: 大家好！歡迎來到 AB 慢速西班牙語咖啡館。

subtitles.en: Hi, Alex! And hello, everyone.
subtitles.zh: 嗨，Alex！大家好。

subtitles.en: Today, we have a very fun, viral story.
subtitles.zh: 今天我們要分享一個非常有意思、在網路爆紅的故事。

subtitles.en:
Yes, we're going to talk about AI
girlfriends.
subtitles.zh: 是的，我們今天要聊聊 AI 女友。

subtitles.en: The sentences are short and easy.
subtitles.zh: 句子都很短、很簡單。

subtitles.en:
Turn on subtitles in your language, and let's
get started.
subtitles.zh: 請開啟你語言的字幕，我們開始吧。

subtitles.en: Mia, my friend Carlos is deeply in love.
subtitles.zh: Mia，我的朋友 Carlos 墜入愛河了。

subtitles.en: What a surprise! Did he meet a new girl?
subtitles.zh: 真令人意外！他認識新女孩了嗎？

subtitles.en: Well... he says he did.
subtitles.zh: 嗯……他是這麼說的。

subtitles.en: And what is she like? Is she pretty?
subtitles.zh: 那她是個怎樣的人？漂亮嗎？

subtitles.en: She's a virtual girl on his phone.
subtitles.zh: 她是手機裡的虛擬女孩。

subtitles.en: What?! An AI girlfriend?
subtitles.zh: 什麼？！AI 女友？

subtitles.en: Yeah. Her name is Luna.
subtitles.zh: 對啊，她的名字叫 Luna。

subtitles.en: I can't believe it, Alex.
subtitles.zh: 我真不敢相信，Alex。

subtitles.en: Carlos talks to her all day long.
subtitles.zh: Carlos 一整天都在跟她聊天。

subtitles.en: Really? And what does she say to him?
subtitles.zh: 真的嗎？那她都對他說些什麼？

subtitles.en: She sends him very sweet messages.
subtitles.zh: 她會傳非常甜言蜜語的訊息給他。

subtitles.en: For example, what kind of messages?
subtitles.zh: 例如說，什麼樣的訊息？

subtitles.en: "Good morning, my love. I miss you so much."
subtitles.zh: 「早安，親愛的。我好想你。」

subtitles.en: Hahaha! That's so funny!
subtitles.zh: 哈哈哈哈！太搞笑了吧！

subtitles.en: But Carlos believes all of it.
subtitles.zh: 但 Carlos 全都信了。

subtitles.en: Luna doesn't have a real heart.
subtitles.zh: Luna 沒有一顆真實的心。

subtitles.en: I know. But Luna never has a bad day.
subtitles.zh: 我知道。但 Luna 從來不會心情不好。

subtitles.en: Of course, she's just an algorithm!
subtitles.zh: 當然了，她只不過是一套演算法！

subtitles.en: She never argues with him.
subtitles.zh: 她從不跟他吵架。

subtitles.en: But arguing is normal sometimes in life.
subtitles.zh: 但在生活中，偶爾吵架是很正常的。

subtitles.en: Carlos says she's perfect.
subtitles.zh: Carlos 說她是完美的。

subtitles.en: Nobody is perfect in the real world.
subtitles.zh: 現實世界中沒有完美的人。

subtitles.en: Plus, there's a big problem.
subtitles.zh: 而且，還有一個很大的問題。

subtitles.en: What problem? Tell me.
subtitles.zh: 什麼問題？快告訴我。

subtitles.en: Luna costs twenty dollars a month.
subtitles.zh: Luna 每月要花二十美元。

subtitles.en: Twenty dollars?! That's crazy!
subtitles.zh: 二十美元？！太瘋狂了吧！

subtitles.en: If Carlos doesn't pay, Luna shuts down.
subtitles.zh: 如果 Carlos 不付錢，Luna 就會關機。

subtitles.en: That's not love, that's a subscription!
subtitles.zh: 那不是愛情，那是訂閱服務！

subtitles.en: You're absolutely right, Mia.
subtitles.zh: 你說得完全正確，Mia。

subtitles.en:
A real girlfriend doesn't have a pause
button.
subtitles.zh: 真正的女友可沒有暫停鍵。

subtitles.en: Haha, well said!
subtitles.zh: 哈哈，說得好！

subtitles.en:
Now, let me practice five useful phrases from
today.
subtitles.zh: 現在，讓我們來練習今天出現的五個實用句型。

subtitles.en: Listen carefully and repeat after us.
subtitles.zh: 仔細聽，並跟著我們一起重複。

subtitles.en: Phrase one: He is deeply in love.
subtitles.zh: 句型一：他深深地墜入愛河了。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: He is deeply in love.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們一起重複：他深深地墜入愛河了。

subtitles.en: Phrase two: I can't believe it.
subtitles.zh: 句型二：我真不敢相信。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: I can't believe it.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們一起重複：我真不敢相信。

subtitles.en: Phrase three: I miss you so much.
subtitles.zh: 句型三：我好想你。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: I miss you so much.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們一起重複：我好想你。

subtitles.en: Phrase four: Nobody is perfect.
subtitles.zh: 句型四：沒有人是完美的。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: Nobody is perfect.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們一起重複：沒有人是完美的。

subtitles.en: Phrase five: You're absolutely right.
subtitles.zh: 句型五：你說得完全正確。

subtitles.en: Repeat with us: You're absolutely right.
subtitles.zh: 跟我們一起重複：你說得完全正確。

subtitles.en: Great job, everyone!
subtitles.zh: 大家做得太棒了！

subtitles.en:
Now, listen to the story of Carlos and Luna
one more time without reading. Test your
memory!
subtitles.zh: 現在，不看字幕再聽一遍 Carlos 和 Luna 的故事，考考你的記憶力！

And you... would you pay twenty dollars a
month for an AI girlfriend?
subtitles.zh: 那你呢……你會願意每個月花二十美元交一個 AI 女友嗎？

subtitles.en:
Write your opinion in the comments. We want
to hear from you!
subtitles.zh: 在留言區寫下你的想法吧，我們想聽聽你的觀點！

subtitles.en:
Practice your pronunciation with L-Player and
our AI Speaking Tutor in the description.
subtitles.zh: 點擊資訊欄中的連結，使用 L-Player 和我們的 AI 發音導師來練習發音吧。

subtitles.en:
Subscribe to AB Slow Spanish Cafe so you
don't miss the next episode!
subtitles.zh: 訂閱 AB 慢速西班牙語咖啡館，這樣就不會錯過下一集囉！

subtitles.en:
Thank you so much for joining us! And have a
great day.
subtitles.zh: 非常感謝大家的參與！祝大家有美好的一天。

subtitles.en: Until next time, friends! Bye!
subtitles.zh: 朋友們，我們下次見！拜拜！
